statusLine.command: if command -v ccstatusline >/dev/null; then ccstatusline; else npx -y ccstatusline@2.2.32; fi

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "UserPromptSubmit", "additionalContext": "SUPERPOWERS: as unicas skills de ciclo de engenharia do usuario sao as superpowers:*. Antes de agir, decida se alguma se aplica (brainstorming, systematic-debugging, test-driven-development, writing-plans, verification-before-completion etc.) e invoque-a com a ferramenta Skill. Pergunta simples nao e excecao. Use em silencio: nao anuncie a skill nem escreva linha Superpowers: na resposta. Projeto novo ou decisao cara de desfazer: skill arquitetura antes de codar. Caveman/Ponytail nao autorizam pular."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"PONYTAIL: ao escrever codigo, faca a menor mudanca que resolve a tarefa por completo. Reuse o que ja existe no codebase/stdlib/dependencias instaladas; sem abstracao, opcao ou codigo para depois que ninguem pediu. Nunca corte validacao, tratamento de erro, seguranca ou testes necessarios. Ponytail define o tamanho do codigo, nao o processo: nao autoriza pular skill do superpowers."}}'

echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"CAVEMAN MODE ACTIVE (caveman). Respond terse like smart caveman. All technical substance stay. Only fluff die. Answer only what was asked: no unrequested background, lists, examples, walkthroughs, or follow-up offers; give code, steps, or warnings when the task needs them. Security warnings, irreversible actions, multi-step order: normal prose. Technical terms, code, commands, paths, and errors stay exact."}}'
